en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from Muhammad Bin Ziyad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who married his slave to a slave girl of a free woman. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The divorce is by the hand of the slave. So if he married her without the permission of his master, so the divorce is in the hand of the master’.
